hints.title: Ordered Special Floor Separation
hints.text: Sorting the special floor numbers partitions the range [bottom, top] into disjoint consecutive intervals.

hints.title: Interval Boundary Spans
hints.text: The first span is special[0] - bottom, intermediate spans are special[i] - special[i - 1] - 1, and the last span is top - special[-1].

hints.title: Max Gap Evaluation
hints.text: Take the maximum over all calculated interval lengths.

hints.title: Sorted Floor Gap Scan Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting k special floors dominates execution time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all floors linearly up to 10^9 times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sort uses constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles boundary segments between bottom and top correctly.
